== Marginal cuts: Dark Side Art Show claim ==
The [[Special:PermanentLink/325661|prior Rogue Asteroid (PC Errata) revision]], and [[Special:PermanentLink/330586|prior Rogue Asteroid (Revised) revision]] carried the potato claim and crop below. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20000422124838/http://www.decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/dagobah/dark/erogueasteroid.html checked Decipher Art Show capture] is filed under the Dark Side card and says that an asteroid is a potato and that potatoes were used as asteroid props during filming. The [[Rogue Asteroid (Dark)|Dark Side card]] and [[Rogue Asteroid (PC Errata)|Light Side card]] have different pictures. That Dark Side source does not establish the photo-specific claim for the Light Side printings; it does not establish that their picture contains no potato either.

The removed fields are retained as prior editorial material, not verified Light Side trivia:

=== Rogue Asteroid (PC Errata) ===

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000422124838/http://www.decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/dagobah/dark/erogueasteroid.html Internet Archive], 22 April 2000.</ref>
